policy: every daemon ships a generated launchd plist AND a sandbox profile; sudo is absent — services are managed via doas + abzu-ctl

packages.name: openssh
packages.role: sshd hardened: KbdInteractiveAuthentication no, root login via doas only

packages.name: unbound
packages.role: local validating resolver (replaces OpenBSD unwind, see userland/import/skip.txt)

packages.name: restic
packages.role: encrypted dedup backups; abzu-init wires a nightly launchd job

packages.name: wireguard-tools
packages.role: userspace wg(8); kernel side uses Darwin NE backend (roadmap R-014)

packages.name: abzu-firewall
packages.role: pf.conf-compatible front-end translating to XNU netinfo/Application Firewall rules

packages.name: gitea
packages.role: optional self-hosted forge for the homelab persona
